en.headline: Observatory expects cooler midweek weather as northeast monsoon arrives
en.dek: A fresh northeast monsoon is forecast to reach the south China coast on Tuesday, bringing a few rain patches and lower temperatures.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a fresh to strong easterly airstream is affecting the south China coast today and tomorrow, bringing cloudier conditions and a slight rise in temperatures.
A northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast on Tuesday, with temperatures falling and a few rain patches midweek, according to the Observatory's 7-day forecast updated on Sunday morning.

Sunday is forecast to be mainly cloudy with bright periods in the morning and one or two light rain patches at night, with temperatures between 20 and 23 degrees. Monday will see highs around 24 degrees before the drop begins.
The Yellow Fire Danger Warning remains in force, with the Observatory advising the public to prevent fires. No other major warnings were reported in force this morning.

zh.headline: 天文台料周二東北季候風抵港 本周中期轉涼有雨
zh.dek: 一股清勁東北季候風預料周二抵達華南沿岸，本周中期氣溫下降及有幾陣雨。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股清勁至強風程度的偏東氣流正影響華南沿岸，今明兩日雲量增多，氣溫略為回升。
天文台周日上午更新的九天天氣預報指，東北季候風預料周二抵達沿岸，本周中期氣溫下降及有幾陣雨。
周日大致多雲，初時部分時間天色明朗，稍後有一兩陣微雨，氣溫約20至23度。周一最高氣溫約24度，其後開始下降。
黃色火災危險警告仍然生效，天文台提醒市民採取防火措施。今早沒有其他主要警告生效。
